comparison.objective: Hold a shower cartridge fully home against O-ring spring-back while inserting its retaining U-clip; candidate commissions and locks an adjustable damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Shower task tests simultaneous axial force, angular alignment, and precise bimanual clip insertion through narrow slots. Candidate tests hex-key engagement, unlock-adjust-lock manipulation, counterholding, fine collar rotation, and repeated response-based adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Shower task requires ≤0.5 mm seating error, <3° rotation, clip fully seated/square, and retention under a 20 N outward pull. Candidate requires two acceptable physical impact cycles and lock stability under a witness-torque test.
comparison.reason: Both require bimanual force control, but one tests holding a spring-backed part during transverse retainer insertion while the other tests dynamic tuning and torque-limited locking. Shower O-ring forces and 0.2 mm clearance are explicitly assumed rather than measured; candidate lacks a numeric drift threshold and calibrated setscrew/collar parameters.
